title: Alpha Wolf
intro: Wolves are one of the most common, and most easily underestimated, dangers on Icarus. Whenever you see one wolf, you should expect two more have already circled behind you. Alpha Wolves do not spawn naturally outside of certain Prospects/Operations, [https://icarus.fandom.com/wiki/CONT4CT_Device#SMPL3_Mission_Types SMPL3 missions], and horde events spawned by using a Vapor Condenser.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 6-10 Bone 10-16 Leather 4-6 Fur 10-20 Raw Stringy Meat 8-15 Black Wolf Tooth

title: Antelope
intro: On Icarus, Antelope make up the most abundant population of herbivores along with their deer cousins. Typically, they can be found in family groups of three or more. As they are sizable and fleet-footed creatures, they are prone to getting spooked easily and are adept at camouflaging themselves in the desert. A black market for Icarus venison has been long suspected. While prospectors aren't supposed to remove any biological matter from the surface, rumors of Icarus meat and produce appearing on earth have been circulating. UDA INTSEC currently investigating. "It just tastes better. Earth feed

title: Arctic Moa
intro: Found in icy terrazone environments. This previously extinct creature had many variants. Specifically found on Icarus is the Dinornis novaezealandiae, the second largest moa species in recorded history. This large flightless bird is the result of genetic experimentation, preserved Moa DNA was found in amber near Tekapo, New Zealand. This was used to revive the extinct species. "Life will find a way... Directly into a prospectors stomach."

title: Arctic Scorpion
intro: Experiment run by Dr Lee. The assumption 'Scorpions are just land lobster' was subject of much discussion. Dr Lee wanted to prove this fast reproducing, meaty arachnid, could be a source of food for prospectors in colder environments. Due to Prospectors having an extreme aversion to dealing with these enlarged scorpions, this line of research had it's funding cut. Somewhat suspiciously, despite the project being canceled, a biological containment unit was discovered planet-side. Seeding the large scorpions on Icarus. Dr Lee is currently under investigation. "This doesn't taste like lobster. **

title: Arctic Vesper
intro: The Arctic Bat is a flying mammal adapted to life in freezing environments. These agile creatures navigate through vast cave systems with impressive echolocation abilities, preying on anything they can find in the cavernous darkness. While nesting these bats can exhibit rather aggressive behaviour, to the extent that the Lagos Group has advised that contractors should leave any nests they find undisturbed. If left untreated, wounds from these creatures can cause severe distress, even death. "Oi, Rob, get over here! Reckon I've found once of them nests they've been harping on about. Hey, don't

title: Arid Striker
intro: Arid Strikers are known for their extremely sharp claws, with an edge keen enough to gut a human in one blow, suit and all. The Arid Striker is one of the reasons the UDA implemented the controversial 'buddy' system. Prospectors with enough spare cash could choose a teammate to drop down with, in order to spot each other through Striker territory. The costs for this were astronomical, and the program was quickly scrapped. "I mean, have you SEEN the claws on those things?! I am never going into the Volcanic areas again. EVER."

title: Ashen Drake
intro: These creatures have developed a remarkable resistance to the harsh heat and toxic environments of the most hostile parts of Icarus. The thick hide of the Ashen Drake works to protect it from the searing heat of the ground it walks on, along with providing excellent defense from other predators. "There I was just minding my own business trying to make it past the lava floes and then WHACK! This thing comes outta nowhere and almost knocked me in. Cheeky git."

title: Baby Deer
intro: Infant deer, commonly seen following their parent through the Icarus wilderness. Has been known to follow other creatures if it's parent dies. Widely considered by prospectors to be one of the most convenient sources of food on Icarus. Killing Baby Deer contributes to the Heartless Accolade. "Bro. Every ol' mate and his dog have had to kill these little critters. It's survival. If you're hurt... tired or slow... They're easier to hunt... But the sound they make when they die... A heavy meal in more ways than one."

title: Bear
intro: Unlike Bears on earth, Icarus Ursus horribilis have no need to hibernate. They also produce offspring at a much higher rate. Introduced to maintain reasonable levels of herbivore fauna. While originally engineered to be more passive unless food motivated, the Bear consistently displays levels of increased aggression towards prospectors. The UDA is not liable for missing appendages, limbs or crewmates. "Not your first thought. One of the biggest initial dangers being bears.... You start to take it seriously after a crewmate is taken or mauled. You know they ******* start eating from the lower h

title: Bear Cub
intro: These cubs are usually found in the forest and wooded areas of Icarus, guarded by their often easily-provoked mothers. An unnamed UDA researcher made a failed attempt to tame Bear cubs from birth, in the hope that they could be used as mounts for prospectors travelling large distances. Needless to say, they did not succeed, or survive. "I mean, they're cute and all but... a mans gotta eat. I'm not proud of it, but sometimes these little fellas are all that stand between me and starvation."

title: Bee
intro: The Bees of Icarus are known for their long, needle-like stingers which are capable of piercing even the toughest of envirosuits. Proceed with caution. Despite the danger, they are still a reasonable source of food for many contractors living long-term on-planet. Bees were introduced to Icarus by the UDA in an attempt to boost local flora levels after the terraforming failed. Initially, they were deemed harmless and used by many prospectors as an easy source of food once a hive had been set up. However, the influence of exotics soon became apparent in their mutation from Earth insects into a f

title: Black Jaguar
intro: The Boss variant of the Jaguar, encountered on certain prospects such as Wet Work: Extermination.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 2-4 Bone 10-16 Leather 1-3 Fur 2-2 Raw Meat 30% Drop Chance 3-5 Raw Stringy Meat

title: Blueback
intro: The Blueback is an Icarus native, while mostly docile it will defend itself when provoked. Displays a symbiotic relationship with local and introduced fauna. When injured it will retreat into its shell, calling on the help of nearby predatory wildlife. Early results of study on the Blueback's call are captivating the scientific community. The call itself is a carrier wave of subsonic and hypersonic information. It seems to amplify aggression in any species with predatory instincts, and create a primal drive to follow the call. Group 15 are particularly interested in replicating this effect. "W

title: Boar
intro: Wild boar are medium-sized mammals with a stocky build, short legs, and bristly hair. They are typically brown or black in color and have curved tusks that protrude from their mouths. Wild boar are strong and aggressive animals that can defend themselves against predators such as wolves and bears. They are also excellent runners and swimmers. However, they can be a nuisance to prospectors. "Space bacon. My favourite part of this cursed rock."

title: Buffalo
intro: Buffalo are large, muscular mammals with shaggy brown fur and a distinctive hump on their shoulders. They have short, curved horns and a broad, flat face with a large, black nose. Buffalo are social animals that can be tamed young by prospectors with a bit of patience. They spend much of their day grazing on grasses and other vegetation. They are also excellent swimmers and can cross rivers and other bodies of water. "Great big ol' lumbering things. At first I thought they were only good for eatin', then I realized you could tame em! And heck if didn't that make things ten times easier on this

title: Cat
intro: These cats are felines that have been cryogenically preserved, their sleek fur untouched by their time spent in space. Emerging from stasis, they retain their natural grace and keen senses, navigating their new home with a sense of curiosity and playfulness. Introduced as part of the Contractor Companion Program, these cats were chosen for their bonding abilities and drive to hunt. Unfortunately, after the first round of trials, it was discovered that the cryo-sleep had destroyed the latter, resulting in some exceptionally lazy cats. However, most contractors reported that they didn't mind thi

title: Cattle (Cow)
intro: Cattle are hardy, domesticated herbivores renowned for their strength and adaptability, that thrive in grassy areas. Valued for their milk, meat, and labor, they are a cornersone of agricultural life, providing sustenance and support to humans. Cattle are social animals and form strong bonds with other members of the their herd. They even have best friends and can become sterssed when separated from them. They also have excellent memories and can remember faces, locations, and even the people who treat them well or poorly. ""

title: Cave Worm
intro: Commonly found in cave systems all across Icarus. This Infant Sandworm is believed to be the second stage of the Worm life cycle. Freshly hatched, these larva like worms use Icarus cave systems as a relatively safe environment to grow. Scientists believe the mineral rich habitat contributes to this growth. "Cave clearing. We all have to do it some time... Though... They're like roaches, always come back eventually."

title: Chala
intro: Derived from the Capra family of goats on Earth, these herbivores are mostly pleasant-mannered and will flee from any noise or commotion. Sadly when introduced to Icarus scientists noticed too late that this species has a habit of getting stuck in awkward places. Unlike their mountain goat bretheren back on Earth, the Chala tend to climb or explore and then accept their fate. "I don't care how 'safe' they are, the eyes freak me out."

title: Chamois
intro: Chamois have a mix of deer and antelope qualities, and will flee at the first sign of a predator. Championed by a French sect of the UDA, the Chamois was introduced to Icarus to encourage diversity, and provide easy game for ill-prepared prospectors. "AH the ol' shammy. Stupid little goat thing. Bear fodder. Feeder of wolves. Meat on legs."

title: Chicken
intro: A is a Transplanted farm animal that provides a source of Eggs and Raw Chicken for Food recipes.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 1-2 Raw White Meat 1 Raw Chicken 50% Drop Chance 1 Egg

title: Clicker
intro: Towering, skeletal insects that move like nightmares on stilts. Clickers stalk the swamp shallows in eerie silence, their translucent limbs swaying with each step. Long tendrils hang from their segmented underbellies, trailing through the air - contact with one delivers a paralytic jolt that leaves most creatures helpless. They aren't aggressive by nature, but their height makes them oblivious to smaller life below. Genetic markers indicate a hybridization of terrestrial roach and crustacean genomes, designed to thrive in high-humidity waste zones. Exposure to both exotics and radiation spurre

title: Columbian Mammoth
intro: A behemoth from prehistory. In the aftermath of failed terraforming, this mammoth variant was released illicitly by a disillusioned geneticist. It found an unexpected home in the newly arctified snowfields of Icarus.

title: Cougar
intro: The cougar subspecies was brought in to control the population of smaller mammals and adapted quickly to the arid regions of Icarus. Much like deer antlers on Earth, experienced prospectors like to show off mounted Cougar heads as a sign of their hunting and survival abilities. "I had to treat a Prospectors severe lacerations on MULTIPLE occasions. They continually attempted to feed and pet large feline species.... Claimed to have discovered a new 'kitty cat' species in the fringe zone.... I've not heard from them in a while."

title: Crocodile
intro: Crocodiles are large, carnivorous reptiles with a long, powerful tail and a broad, armored body. They have sharp teeth and a distinctive, elongated snout. Crocodiles are solitary animals that spend much of their time basking in the sun or submerged in water. They are ambush predators that lie in wait for prey, which includes fish, birds, and mammals. "Crocodiles are... easy. They try to kill and eat you. Now the UDA... That's a reptile to be afraid of."

title: Deer
intro: On Icarus, deer make up the most abundant population of herbivores. Typically, they can be found in family groups of three or more. As they are sizable and fleet-footed creatures, they are prone to getting spooked easily and are adept at camouflaging themselves in the forest. A black market for Icarus venison has been long suspected. While prospectors aren't supposed to remove any biological matter from the surface, rumors of Icarus meat and produce appearing on earth have been circulating. UDA INTSEC are currently investigating. "It just tastes better. Earth feed is crap in comparison... Sure

title: Dog
intro: Dogs are loyal and beloved domesticated mammals known for their unwavering devotion and diverse breeds. With a keen sense of smell and boundless energy, these affectionate animals enrich the lives of humans as faithful companions and trusted helpers, embodying the timeless bond between humans and their four-legged friends back on Earth. Introduced as part of the Contractor Companion Program, these dogs were chosen for their bonding abilities with humans. Icarus is known to be a harsh and unforgiving environment, where loneliness can set in quickly. These dogs were frozen in cryo-sleep and tran

title: Drac
intro: A genetically mutated form of the Eurasian wolf, cause of the genetic aberration is unknown. Its vampire bat like features lead to prospectors informally referring to the creature as Dracula, eventually shortened to Drac. The Drac has lost many of its wolf like traits. Its enlarged teeth and jaw musculature are a serious threat. It will occasionally howl to call for help when hunting. Due to an infrared reflecting film on the surface of their eyes, at a distance they can be seen glowing red. "I was assigned to Sci-ops in the fringe zone. Chasing some theory Dr Lee had about something living ar

title: Draven
intro: Dravens are hardy, thick-skinned desert dwellers built to endure the scorching winds and blistering heat of Icarus's arid biomes. Their muscular bodies store both water and energy, allowing them to roam for days without rest. Normally docile, they can become aggressive when threatened - and their powerful legs make them dangerous foes up close. Descended from Earth camels genetically modified for off-world colonization, Dravens were designed to survive extreme dehydration and radiation exposure. Over time, environmental adaptation on Icarus has thickened their hides and altered their physiolog

title: Dreadwing
intro: These birds can be found in the most inhospitable areas of Icarus. They feed on other creatures and are highly aggresive, making them disliked by contractors working in their territory. Often mistaken for the relatively harmless Kea, the Dreadwing's hunting behaviour more closely resembles that of the Australian Magpie, it utilizes swift diving to attack its unfortunate prey. "First it's bears and then wolves and now we got these damn things dive-bombing us from the skies? I can't work in these conditions."

title: Dribbo
intro: The result of another of Dr Lee's unsanctioned experiments, the Dribbo as it's been named by prospectors has become somewhat of an example of when science goes too far. Illegal genetic splicing of Earth hippo DNA and Icarus native DNA resulted in these curious-looking creatures. Once released planetside they were quick to reproduce, but the influence of Exotics quickly mutated some offspring. All Dribbo share beak-like mouth features, however some Exotic-affected creatures slowly developed an odd spiked protrusion. Research has shown that this is the egg that the creature hatches from, which t

title: Drifter
intro: Drifters were affectionately named after the way they float through the air, much like a jellyfish moves through water on Earth. They are generally passive creatures but will retaliate if threatened. Getting too close to this creature may cause them to attack, releasing a cloud of gas that acts similarly to a nerve agent. Some daring prospectors have taken to using this attack against other land-based creatures. "They are strangely beautiful, nice to look at from a distance though. I wouldn't want to get too close to one, I quite like my brain the way it is."

title: Drone
intro: TPS Drones are armed aerial units deployed across contested regions, operating with a mix of autonomous systems and remote piloting. Designed for relentless engagement, they pursue targets until destroyed, showing no capacity for retreat or self-preservation. Their constant movement, precision fire, and ability to reposition quickly make them a persistent threat, especially in open terrain. Developed and fielded by the People's Syndicate, these drones reflect TPS's shift from protest and propaganda to direct action. Built from scavenged industrial components and repurposed military hardware, t

title: Drosik
intro: A medium-sized tundra herbivore, the Drosik grazes on sparse grasses and lichen while remaining highly alert to threats. Its single long horn curves backward over its head, seemingly more for display than defense. Extremely skittish, Drosik flee at the slightest disturbance, making them difficult to approach. Introduced to tundra regions by early scientists as a grazing species, the Drosik has since adapted to the harsh conditions on-planet. Some populations show subtle mutations from prolonged exposure to exotics, slightly increasing horn length and herd vigilance. "One startled, and the whol

title: Dune Raptor
intro: The Raptor is a swift, bipedal predator found across the desert and geothermal biomes. Built for speed and endurance, it uses powerful legs and curved talons to bring down prey with precision strikes. Despite its size, it moves with surprising agility, making it one of the deadliest hunters on Icarus. Originally bred as a terraforming control species to manage invasive herbivores, the Raptor adapted rapidly to the planet's extremes. Desert variants developed lighter hides and heat-resistant scales, while geothermal strains evolved thicker skin and increased aggression. Prospectors have since d

title: Elephant
intro: This species was hunted to near-extinction on earth. and was introduced to Icarus as a means of regenerating their population. Found In Arid environments, the African Elephant was genetically modified to make them less desirable to poachers. Alterations were made to the structure of their tusks causing them to degrade over time, when separated from the elephant. Effectively halting the ivory trade. "Something was... lost in the genetic reconstruction of this species. African Elephants on earth are intelligent, self-aware creatures. In multiple instances they've passed the MSR test. Icarus Loxo

title: Excortis the Wooly
intro: Once extinct on Earth, Mammoths were brought to Icarus and can be found in the arctic regions. Originaly, they were brought to be assist with repopulation efforts due to their strength and size, they are rarely seen anymore. Group 15 once studied a massive Mammoth that seemed to be affected by Exotic Materials.
resource: Leather Fur Bone Raw Meat Raw Prime Meat Mammoth Tusk

title: Fish 01
intro: Found in the waters of the terraformed zones on Icarus.

title: Fish 02
intro: Found in the waters of the terraformed zones on Icarus.

title: Fish 03
intro: Various type of fish were populated in the waters of Icarus. Due to what is assume exotic interference, some of the fish have become hostile and poisonous. Typically fish do not mind prospectors but these mutant fish will actively seek out and attack when entering their waters.

title: Frostfoot
intro: Frostfoots are bulky, frost-coated omnivores roughly the size of an Earth Grizzly, but far more irritable. Their dense white fur insulates a muscular frame built for short, explosive bursts of speed, and the curved horns serve as both intimidation display and battering implement. Their name comes from their wide, heat-retentive paws, which allow them to traverse ice sheets without slipping - unfortunately, they also allow Frostfoots to stomp a prospector into the snow with unnerving stability. Originally introduced by Norex as a hardy cold-biome work animal prototype, Frostfoots adapted too we

title: Garganutan
intro: The Garganutan is the direct result of unsanctioned experimentation conducted on the surface of Icarus. Researchers were trying to gather data on the effect of exotics on the brain, and whether it could increase the capability of some animals to learn faster, or to a greater extent. Garganutans will often use their surroundings to their advantage in a fight. This is due to their chemically enlarged hippocampus. Because of their enhanced intellect, most prospectors will abandon any conflict or interaction with these creatures out of fear for their safety. "Rounding up a few creatures here and t

title: Gaseous Floater
intro: Gaseous Floaters are buoyant, sack-like organisms that drift slowly through geothermal regions, suspended by internal gas pockets. Their swollen bodies are laced with volatile compounds, and any sudden impact-particularly contact with the ground-causes an immediate explosive rupture. While they move passively, their unpredictable descent paths make them an ever-present environmental hazard. These organisms are believed to have evolved around geothermal vents where toxic gases are abundant. Over time, their internal structures adapted to store and metabolize volatile compounds for buoyancy, wit

title: Glaci
intro: The UDA regrets to inform you that there is minimal research available on this creature. It appears to be the result of prohibited experimentation by an illegal branch of the company Norex- [REDACTED] This subspecies of Viscid has been observed to attack using frost and seems to be quite resistant to fire. The mutation facilitated by [REDACTED] has increased its strength and gene- [The remainder of this report is illegible and covered in slime] "A viscid? Out here? Oh damn it, it hit me! Jax wait, I can't move!"

title: Gribbler
intro: Gribblers are small, fur-covered omnivores that scuttle across the tundra with unnerving speed. Their forward-leaning gait and elongated forelimbs give them a hunched, almost primate-like profile, though whatever face they once had has collapsed into a puckered, tooth-studded maw. They scavenge more than they hunt, but desperation - or opportunity - can drive them into sudden melee scrambles. Some have developed the charming habit of lobbing whatever they can grab: ice chunks, bones, frozen filth... all fair game. Believed to be descendants of an introduced small mammal species, Gribblers adap

title: Hopper
intro: Low-slung and wide-framed, Hoppers move in a series of explosive bounds that make them hard to track and even harder to avoid. Their wing-like forelimbs don't grant true flight, but they act as stabilizers and shock absorbers when landing, letting the creature ricochet across swamp muck or volcanic scree with unsettling agility. Small but vicious, they favor ambushes - launching themselves straight at a target's torso or face. Believed to descend from a terraforming pest-control species, Hoppers were originally meant to keep invasive insects in check. Exposure to exotic particulates in geother

title: Hyena
intro: These medium-sized carnivores have distinctive spotted fur and powerful jaws. They are often thought of as scavengers but they are also skilled hunters. Considered the pranksters of Icarus, these creatures are known to attack prospectors for no discernible reason and then laugh at their victims. "You think the wolves are bad? I had two of them Hyena things circling my base the other day. Howling is easy to ignore but the laughing? That just drives me MAD."

title: Ignari
intro: These gentle creatures are often found in the hotter parts of Icarus, and are easily frightened by loud noises and disturbances in their vicinity. In most instances they will flee from humans. The Ignari is generally harmless but can be highly territorial. They tend to leave slime trails around their territory. They have also been known to leave trails around man-made structures, this has resulted in a handful of contractors being evacuated to orbit with life-threatening injuries after accidentally stepping onto a trail. "Like a trail of snot, couldn't believe it when I woke up and looked out

title: Jaguar
intro: The jaguar was introduced to regulate the population of smaller mammals and quickly adapted to forest and wooded areas in the terraformed zones of Icarus. Jaguars are solitary and territorial animals that are primarily active at dawn and dusk. They are skilled hunters and prey on a variety of animals, including chamois, deer, and nosy prospectors.. no matter how much of a 'cat person' they may be. "Tried to make a BIG ball of fiber hoping this little cutie would play with it. Didn't work out as well as I had hoped... But hey. You only need one kidney."

title: Kea
intro: A large, intelligent parrot, originally native to New Zealand. On Earth, the Kea population continues to steadily decline. Seeding on Icarus was seen as a way to keep the species alive. Genetically modified to handle harsher conditions. Dr Amelia Tohu personally oversaw this project, having spent time raising Kea in conservation sectors as a young girl. Tohu was uncompromising in her commitment to propagating the species. "Careful of the cheeky buggers. They're not dangerous or anything, but they'll steal food right out from under ya nose. Hell, they'll rip the seals right off your dropship wi

title: Kiwi
intro: Kiwis are flightless birds native to New Zealand on Earth. They are characterized by their small size, round body, long beak, and distinctive nocturnal habits. With highly developed senses of smell and touch, they forage for various insects and fruits under the cover of darkness. On Earth, Kiwis play a crucial ecological role as seed dispersers, contributing to the health and diversity of their ecosystems. It was hoped that they would do the same on Icarus after the terraforming failed to spread various plants across the face of the planet. Kiwis were introduced to Icarus to help diversify the

title: Komodo
intro: Komodo dragons are large, carnivorous reptiles with a long, powerful tail and a rough, scaly skin. They have sharp, curved teeth and a forked tongue. Komodo dragons are solitary animals that are active during the day. They are ambush predators that hunt prey such as deer, boar, and buffalo. They are also known to scavenge carrion. "Damn things have a cesspool in their mouths. Some... Fifty different bacterial strains. Handful of which are exceedingly septic. AND a venom gland in their lower jaw. WHY."

title: Korrin
intro: Small, deer-like herbivore adapted to desert survival. Korrin have unusually large ears and eyes, likely for detecting predators and regulating body temperature in open terrain. A tiny snout hints at selective grazing on sparse desert vegetation. Extremely flighty, Korrin will bolt at the slightest hint of danger. Introduced to desert zones as part of early terraforming efforts, Korrin have thrived in harsh, open environments. Some isolated populations show minor mutations from prolonged exposure to exotics, enhancing their sensory organs for survival in the heat and sandstorms. "One twitch of

title: Large Antelope
intro: Roams the desert biomes of Icarus.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 10-16 Leather 2-4 Bone 2-2 Raw Meat 50% Chance 1-4 Fur 10% Drop Chance 3-5 Raw Game Meat

title: Lava Broodling
intro: These smaller specimens are the direct offspring of Lava Hunters, with tough skin that is incredibly resistant to heat. These creatures tend to work as a swarm to attack threats; flying, biting and generally wearing down their enemies over time. "Agh- no- oof- get OFF me you gross little creepy thing- AHH it BIT me!"

title: Mammoth
intro: A behemoth from prehistory. In the aftermath of failed terraforming, this mammoth variant was released illicitly by a disillusioned geneticist. It found an unexpected home in the newly arctified snowfields of Icarus.

title: Moa
intro: Found in moderate terrazone environments. This previously extinct creature had many variants. Specifically found on Icarus is the Dinornis novaezealandiae, the second largest moa species in recorded history. This large flightless bird is the result of genetic experimentation, preserved Moa DNA was found in amber near Tekapo, New Zealand. This was used to revive the extinct species. "Life will find a way... Directly into a prospectors stomach."

title: Needler
intro: A genetically mutated form of the Crocodile or Komodo. Its exact origins are unknown, but samples show earth species genetic markers. Able to move swiftly underwater and deep in mud; this predator keeps its prey at range while showering its target with organic bone-like spines. "Good god, who thought it was a good idea to mix those genes together? I mean- HELLO? This thing is deadl-"

title: Plains Equix
intro: The Equix can be found in areas of Icarus with many different climates, it adapts to its surroundings swiftly and efficiently. It is believed that the Equix is a mix of deer and earth antelope DNA, but the exact details are closely guarded by the UDA. "Blast me! I always thought my team were saying 'he's quick', didn't know these critters had a real name"

title: Polar Bear
intro: Polar bears can be found in colder areas of the Terrazone. Originally seeded to promote biodiversity in the Icarus food chain. Due to their increased aggression and predatory instincts they quickly wiped out the seal population. Valued by prospectors for their meat but especially for their fur which can be used to craft armor to protect against the harsh climates of Icarus. Generally avoided by novice prospectors. "Valued by prospectors for their meat but especially for their fur which can be used to craft armor to protect against the harsh climates of Icarus. Generally avoided by novice prosp

title: Polar Bear Cub
intro: Found in colder parts of Icarus, these tiny versions of their parents are generally considered to be easy pickings for hungry predators... and prospectors. Polar bear cubs are born blind and deaf, making them heavily dependent on their mothers for the first few months of life. Do I wish I could keep one as a pet? Absolutely. Would it be likely to tear my face off in my sleep? Absolutely.

title: Pronghorn
intro: Pronghorns were originally introduced to Icarus to add variety to the population and give prospectors a good challenge at target practice. Pronghorns are incredibly fast runners, which makes them difficult prey for predators. They also have excellent eyesight and can detect movement miles away. However, they are not as agile as other animals, which can make them vulnerable to predators in certain situations. "I swear. It's like they have magnets in their horns. You spend ages stalk'n them, get up as close as you can... line up your shot... THUNK! Arrow falls to the ground. Looks like I'm going

title: Pygmy Lop
intro: Believed to be a mutation of the earth-like Rabbit, this creature is known for its uncanny ability to sense danger from a great distance. The Pygmy Lop is another creature that the UDA has released a warning for, as studies have shown that they cannot be tamed or kept as a pet. "Don't pet the fluffy little darlings?? Why on earth would I listen to that rubbish? This one here is called Imelda and her friend over here is called Twiggy. They help me to finish off my dinner each night and in return I , uh, ATTEMPT to give them some snuggles."

title: Quarrite
intro: Believed to be native to Icarus, the Quarrite is a peculiar creature that upon first glance appears to be made of rocks. This is its armor which must first be removed in order to damage the creature. It can often be found in arid, rocky terrain which helps it to blend in with its surroundings. Quarrites have a rather remarkable skill which consists of consuming entire mineral deposits to strengthen and replenish their armor-like coating. They then use this armor to trample or roll over their prey, to great effect. "Creatures of interest? No one said anything about banging my head against a lit

title: Queen Bee
intro: Queen Bees are present in Wild and Cave Beehives with a drop chance of 30%. Placing a Queen Bee in a Beehive Breeding Center will produce 10 Worker Bees before the Queen Bee dies and needs replacing. A Queen Bee can be used for making Honeycomb in the Beehive Extractor

title: Rabbit
intro: They have large, furry feet that provide traction on icy surfaces, and long, floppy ears that help regulate their body temperature. They are very vulnerable to predators, and easily startled. These are social animals that live in groups called herds, spending much of their time foraging for food in the snow. They are herbivores and feed on a variety of plants. "Quick little critters keep gettin' into my food stores. If they keep mucking me around I'll see if they have better manners as a pair of socks."

title: Raptor
intro: The Raptor is a swift, bipedal predator found across the desert and geothermal biomes. Built for speed and endurance, it uses powerful legs and curved talons to bring down prey with precision strikes. Despite its size, it moves with surprising agility, making it one of the deadliest hunters on Icarus. Originally bred as a terraforming control species to manage invasive herbivores, the Raptor adapted rapidly to the planet's extremes. Desert variants developed lighter hides and heat-resistant scales, while geothermal strains evolved thicker skin and increased aggression. Prospectors have since d

title: Ravager
intro: Ravagers are massive, volcanic-dwelling arthropods that resemble boulders until they decide otherwise. Curled tight, they pass for part of the terrain - a convenient heat sink basking in lava vents. When disturbed, the creature unfurls with startling speed, revealing powerful wings and a mouth built to crack stone. These giants trace back to reinforced mining-support organisms originally developed to clear debris in extreme temperatures. In volcanic biomes saturated with exotic particulates and radiation, their physiology pushed into overdrive: chitin hardened into near-ceramic shielding, musc

title: Reaver
intro: This creature is often hard to spot in its swampy habitat as it spends most of its time submerged. This gives it the element of surprise which has unfortunately resulted in much missing data from researchers sent out into the field. These creatures have poor vision but a keen sense of hearing, and are almost impossible to kill while submerged. Some prospectors have taken to leaving an animal corpse nearby to lure them into the open in order to run to safety or to finally finish them off. "Imagine a massive lobster, but it's evil. That's a Reaver."

title: Redback
intro: The Redback is an Icarus native, evolved for volcanic environments. While mostly docile it will defend itself when provoked. Displays a symbiotic relationship with local and introduced fauna. When injured it will retreat into its shell, calling on the help of nearby predatory wildlife. Believed to be a distant cousin of the Blueback. These creatures are well known for their distinctive calls, which are believed to be able to manipulate other creatures. This does include humans, as many prospectors have taken to defending Redbacks and keeping them as pets. "Sure they look a bit weird at first b

title: Revanent
intro: Revenants represent the final stage of human-afflicted radiation-exotic toxicity-an escalation far beyond Spectres and Wraiths. Barely recognizable as once-human, these creatures have grown massive under prolonged exposure to radioactive exotic concentrations. Their elongated limbs, hardened growths, and erratic movement patterns make them unpredictable and extremely dangerous. Revenants exhibit heightened aggression and resilience, capable of withstanding significant damage while delivering devastating melee attacks with irradiated claws. Like Spectres and Wraiths, Revenants originate from hu

title: Rimetusk
intro: Revived ancient earth species. A well preserved sample was found deep in the Le Brea tar pits, the first few mammoths were carried by elephants as surrogate mothers. Due to significant debate on the ethics of the mammoths revival, the experiment had to be conducted on Icarus. Extremist group TPS was responsible for the organisation of global protests against the revival of this species. While this study was not the most advanced genetics experiment, it became a pivotal reference in arguments against genetic augmentation. A slippery slope to experimentation on humans. "While we appreciate new t

title: Roat
intro: One of the first creatures to be discovered outside the Earth-like Terrazone, the Roat is a small creature that is heavily adapted to its environment. Their temperament can change rapidly, catching many contractors off guard. Prospectors have been warned by the UDA not to feed the Roats, although it is suspected that many ignore this warning. Much like seagulls on Earth, Roats can get quite aggressive when food is involved. "You get used to them after a while, funny little things. Some of them have quite the temper but I have found a few of them to be quite endearing... although that could be

title: Sandhorn
intro: Sandhorns are towering, slow-moving desert leviathans whose shells look more like eroded mesas than living armor. Their massive front horn is used primarily for shoving aside boulders and uprooting scrub, but it becomes a devastating weapon if provoked. Despite their size, Sandhorns are herbivores with calm dispositions - provided you don't startle them, corner them, or sneeze too loudly within a five-meter radius. Introduced as part of early terraforming experiments, Sandhorns were meant to stabilize shifting dunes and aerate soil as they grazed. Exotics interacted with their mineral-rich die

title: Scorpion
intro: Experiment run by Dr Lee. The assumption 'Scorpions are just land lobster' was subject of much discussion. Dr Lee wanted to prove this fast reproducing, meaty arachnid, could be a source of food for prospectors in arid environments. Due to Prospectors having an extreme aversion to dealing with these enlarged scorpions, this line of research had it's funding cut. Somewhat suspiciously, despite the project being canceled, a biological containment unit was discovered planet-side. Seeding the large scorpions on Icarus. Dr Lee is currently under investigation. "This doesn't taste like lobster. ****

title: Scuttler
intro: Scuttlers are small, scarab-like arthropods common in volcanic biomes, typically found clustering around carcasses. Although passive at first, they display a wary vigilance-remaining still and observing anyone who comes near. Once a threat moves off, they swarm the corpse in quick, coordinated bursts. If a prospector lingers too long or interferes directly, Scuttlers will abandon their usual caution and attack with surprising ferocity for their size. Adapted to extreme heat and toxic soil, Scuttlers evolved as opportunistic scavengers in environments where larger predators rarely linger. Their

title: Shaggy Zebra
intro: These odd-looking creatures are believed to be a mutation directly resulting from the work done in Group 15 labs to integrate the genetically engineered Zebra into the Icarus food chain. It is theorised that this herd of Zebra quietly migrated into an unsupervised part of Icarus and were heavily affected by the surrounding exotic matter. The team who stumbled across them on a recon mission of the area took several weeks to recover from the shock. "We thought we were prepared, they said there was nothing living in there. All of a sudden Tony turns around and runs past me and I come face to face

title: Sheep
intro: A sheep preserved in cryogenic stasis that can be deployed and defrosted on a planet. Can be Researched at the Orbital Exchange Interface for 500 Ren and 250 Exotics. Once researched sheep can be crafted for 250 Ren each.

title: Skulk
intro: Stocky, low to the ground, and armored with jagged dorsal spines, the Skulk is a predator built for ambush in the frozen wastes. Its dense, muscle-packed frame lets it plow through snowdrifts with surprising speed, while its thick hide shrugs off most projectiles. It hunts by sound and vibration, often lurking beneath snow until prey strays too close - then erupting upward in a flurry of claws and teeth. Genetic analysis suggests the Skulk originated from an early terraforming fauna program - possibly a hybrid between an armored boar and a tundra bear, later warped by long-term exposure to rad

title: Skulmutt
intro: Lean and feral, Skulmutts prowl the irradiated wastes in packs, their skin thinned and split until the bone of their skulls gleams through like pale armor. Their movements are twitchy and erratic - fast when they strike, faster when they flee - and their howls have a warped, metallic timbre that echoes across dead valleys. They show signs of pack coordination and uncanny intelligence, often circling prey into open ground before attacking from multiple angles. DNA traces suggest they're the remnants of early canine stock, released to help control small wildlife during the first colonization pha

title: Slinker
intro: The Slinker prowls the tundra biome, its sleek frame and low stance built for silent pursuit across frozen plains. Its deep blue coat and faint stripes make it nearly invisible in twilight, striking fast from cover. Highly aggressive, it hunts alone, preferring ambush tactics over drawn-out chases. Genetic records suggest the Slinker originated from a hybridized predator species introduced during early terraforming trials. Adaptations to extreme cold (including heat-retentive fur and enhanced musculature) made it one of the few apex predators to thrive post-collapse. Attempts to contain the po

title: Snow Leopard
intro: Snow leopards are large, muscular cats with thick, white fur that helps them blend into their snowy mountain habitat. They have distinctive black spots and rosettes on their fur, and their long, bushy tail provides balance and warmth in cold temperatures. Snow leopards are solitary animals. They are highly adapted to their mountain habitat and are able to climb steep, rocky terrain with ease. They are also skilled hunters and prey on a variety of animals, but are often killed for their valuable fur. "Aren't they just the fuzziest? I've had these two following me for the last few days, some wou

title: Snow Rabbit
intro: Snow Rabbits are common, and exceedingly fast. They are notoriously skittish and difficult to approach, even when a prospector is employing Stealth. They dart in and around the Arctic of Icarus, their relative the Rabbit makes its home in the Forest. Processing a Snow Rabbit's carcass will produce a small yield of several useful Animal Resources. Snow Rabbit Carcesses can be transported to a Skinning Bench where resource yields are substantially increased.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 1-3 Bone 1-1 Raw Meat 50% Drop Chance 1-2 Fur 10% Drop Chance 3-5 Raw Soft Meat

title: Snow Stalker
intro: The Stalker has a strong pack mentality, oriented around small family groups. The only creature native to Icarus to show such intense bonds. It's strong, agile and smart. The perfect hunter. Stalkers are regarded as one of the more, if not the most frightening creatures found on Icarus. While there are larger, more aggressive creatures, the stalker is intelligent. Living up to their name, Prospectors report being followed for hours - days even, the stalker biding its time to strike. Ambush behavior is common, it's highly recommended to request help when dealing with these creatures. "At first

title: Snow Wolf
intro: Genetically engineered Eurasian wolf, designed for a harsh and cold climate. The most common predator within terraformed environments. Wolves are skilled pack hunters that are capable of taking down prey many times their size. The subspecies introduced to Icarus are far more aggressive than those on Earth, and become easily fixated on humans who wander into their territory. "Chills. Down. Your. Spine. You try getting to sleep while a ghastly choir of howling surrounds ya makeshift camp. Its downright unsettling."

title: Spectre
intro: Spectres tend to wander radioactive zones, their body warped and decayed by prolonged exposure to exotic contamination. Once human, these figures now move with jerky, unnatural precision, glowing faintly in the dark with residual energy. Their claws and distorted limbs make close encounters lethal, and radiation levels spike wherever they roam. Believed to be prospectors who lingered too long near unstable exotic deposits, Spectres are grim evidence of Icarus' mutagenic potential. The exotic matter fused with organic tissue, keeping the host animated long past viability. Whether driven by inst

title: Spider
intro: Spiders spawns can be disabled by enabling Arachnophobia Mode in the Custom World Settings menu inside an Open World or Prospect. This settings menu is available by pressing Escape while in a Prospect and is not part of the general Settings menu. If your save was created before the Week 211 update, the Arachnophobia Mode must be specifically disabled for the creatures to start spawning. All new saves will have Arachnophobia Mode disabled by default and the setting can be toggled on or off at any time in the Custom World Settings menu.

title: Stomper
intro: Standing tall on wiry legs and crowned with bright plumage, the Stomper is an elegant creature. Its oversized talons and reinforced leg bones make it deceptively powerful, capable of breaking stone or skulls with a single strike. Normally, the Stomper wanders volcanic plains in small herds, pecking through ash for mineral-rich roots and insects. When threatened, though, it unleashes thunderous stomps that can crack stone. Believed to have descended from Earth's ratites, the Stomper's physiology shows clear exotic-radiation mutation - the heat-resistant feathers and shock-dampening tendons aren

title: Stonejaw
intro: A large predator with a rock-like outer coating that protects it from most damage. Stonejaw were one of the first subspecies to be discovered on Icarus as a result of exotic mutation. Scientists have yet to confirm if its bite has been enhanced with venom due to contractors being eaten before they have the chance to inspect their wounds. "Buggers get more and more pissed off until they explode at someone. Frustrating as HELL to deal with."

title: Storca
intro: Storcas are mid-sized predators native to the tundra, built for agility and endurance in low-visibility conditions. Their lightweight frames, long limbs, and heat-sensing cranial organs allow them to navigate blizzards and frozen terrain without relying on sight. Though cautious and often aggressive toward intruders, Storcas show surprisingly social behavior among their own kind and can be playful in groups, especially when not threatened. With careful training, they can even be domesticated as companions. Storcas developed in regions where extreme cold and diffuse exotic exposure disrupted ty

title: Stryder
intro: With their long legs and height these creatures move surprisingly swiftly when in marshy areas. They are generally passive unless provoked. Believed to be endemic to Icarus, the Stryder seems purpose built for muddy terrain. They are timid creatures that will flee at the slightest provocation. "Cute lil turtle guys with their floppy eyes, running all over the damn place. No idea what to do with them, but they make my day each time I see 'em"

title: Sulfur Vesper
intro: Sulfur Vespers are bat-like aerial pests commonly found in geothermal regions, nesting around vents, caves, and unstable rock formations. They are highly aggressive and will swarm anything that enters their territory, relying on rapid flight and repeated dive attacks. While individually fragile, their numbers and erratic movement make them a constant hazard in certain zones. These creatures are believed to have evolved from small flying mammals that adapted to geothermal environments. Prolonged exposure to sulfur gases altered their respiratory systems and heightened their aggression, allowing

title: Sulfur Worm
intro: Sulfur Worms are colossal burrowing invertebrates that lurk beneath the crust of geothermal basins, using sulfur pools as both camouflage and incubator. Most of their bulk stays submerged, but when prey wanders too close, they surge upward in a violent eruption of steam and acid vapors. Their primary attack is projecting sticky, sulfur-rich globs that are best avoided. Originally adapted to subsistence in sulfuric aquifers, these worms underwent drastic changes in geothermal regions where exotics accumulate underground. The combination of extreme heat, toxic chemistry, and radiation accelerate

title: Sulfuric Spider
intro: Spiders spawns can be disabled by enabling Arachnophobia Mode in the Custom World Settings menu inside an Open World or Prospect. This settings menu is available by pressing Escape while in a Prospect and is not part of the general Settings menu. If your save was created before the Week 211 update, the Arachnophobia Mode must be specifically disabled for the creatures to start spawning. All new saves will have Arachnophobia Mode disabled by default and the setting can be toggled on or off at any time in the Custom World Settings menu.

title: Swamp Hopper
intro: Low-slung and wide-framed, Hoppers move in a series of explosive bounds that make them hard to track and even harder to avoid. Their wing-like forelimbs don't grant true flight, but they act as stabilizers and shock absorbers when landing, letting the creature ricochet across swamp muck or volcanic scree with unsettling agility. Small but vicious, they favor ambushes - launching themselves straight at a target's torso or face. Believed to descend from a terraforming pest-control species, Hoppers were originally meant to keep invasive insects in check. Exposure to exotic particulates in geother

title: Swamp Roat
intro: A rat like creature that is skittish.
resource: 100% Drop Chance 5-8 Leather 3-6 Fur 1-2 Bone 1-2 Raw Meat 50% Drop Chance 3-5Potato 3-5Tomato 20% Drop Chance 1-3 Acidic Glands

title: Teenage Caveworm
intro: Adolescent Sandworms that have outgrown the nest. Found all over Icarus, they spend most of their time deep underground. It's theorized - due to the relative prevalence of adolescents and the significantly smaller numbers of fully grown worms, that many do not live past this stage. "We think they only surface to hunt... It's terrifying to think how many could be under our feet as we speak. Since they spend so much time underground, we just don't know much about them"

title: Terrenus
intro: The Terrenus is an engineered descendant of Earth's horses. Its compact, sturdy build allows for swift movement through most areas. Sinotai came to find that genetic splicing with Eurasian wild boar resulted in significantly heightened endurance in these creatures. Unlike their predecessors, the Terrenus is less likely to flee a predator - using its tusks to defend themselves and their kin. Initial reports on Terrenus development showed concern regarding their ability to be trained for use on time-sensitive drops, where Contractors needed a reliable source of swift transportation. The first ba

title: Tusker
intro: The Tusker's four eyes help them to detect threats at a far greater accuracy than similar earth-like creatures such as the Bison. Capable of fighting off aggressive wildlife, the Tusker's increased stamina and deadly protrusions make it a strong choice for prospectors looking for a companion in the harsh wilderness of Icarus. Found only in the coldest parts of the Terrazone, these creatures were discovered by an ACS scientist while setting up a forward base for weather monitoring. An avid storm chaser, their bravery led them to follow a family of Tuskers deep into the ice, documenting as much

title: Ubis
intro: The genetics team didn't quite get the size of the Ubis right, but as these creatures can be tamed (with some difficulty), many prospectors are more than happy about the mistake. A genetic descendant of the Earth Flamingo, this creature has thrived since being introduced to Icarus. Instead of shrimp their colour is derived from the influence of nearby exotics. "Never thought much of Flamingos on earth... this fella though, I've seen them knock a prospector out cold in one kick. Want some advice? Stay outta range."

title: Venomfly
intro: Bright-winged but mean-tempered, Venomflies hover at head height with a jittery, aggressive energy. Their limbs are built for gripping bark and exposed roots, and their oversized red eyes track movement with unnerving precision. While not large enough to be apex predators, they more than make up for it with painful stings and fast, darting flight patterns. Originally engineered as a pollinator species for wetland reclamation, Venomflies were meant to resist swampborne parasites and fungal rot. Post-collapse radiation surges interacting with exotic particulate triggered hyper-territorial behavi

title: Viscid
intro: These gentle creatures are often found in swampy parts of Icarus, and are easily frightened by loud noises and disturbances in their vicinity. In most instances they will flee from humans. The Viscid is generally harmless but can be highly territorial. They tend to leave slime trails around their territory; favouring large bodies of water. They have also been known to leave trails around man-made structures, this has resulted in a handful of contractors being evacuated to orbit with life-threatening injuries after accidentally stepping onto a trail. "Like a trail of snot, couldn't believe it w

title: Wolf
intro: Genetically engineered Eurasian wolf, designed for various climates. Most common predator within terraformed environments. Wolves are skilled pack hunters that are capable of taking down prey many times their size. The subspecies introduced to Icarus are far more aggressive than those on Earth, and become easily fixated on humans who wander into their territory. "Chills. Down. Your. Spine. You try getting to sleep while a ghastly choir of howling surrounds ya makeshift camp. Its downright unsettling."

title: Woolly Mammoth
intro: A behemoth from prehistory. In the aftermath of failed terraforming, this mammoth variant was released illicitly by a disillusioned geneticist. It found an unexpected home in the newly arctified snowfields of Icarus.

title: Worker Bee
intro: Worker Bees are present in all Wild and Cave Beehives with a drop chance of 100%. They are hostile within proximity and will follow a prospector. Melee weapons can be used to kill bees and one strike is sufficient to kill a swarm. Bee stings affect speed and can stack 5 times.

title: Wraith
intro: Wraiths are towering, heavily mutated remnants of human origin, their limbs stretched beyond natural limits and bodies studded with crystalline growths. Found deep within irradiated zones, they move with terrifying speed and precision, attacking anything that enters their territory. Contractors report that radiation levels spike sharply when one is near. Unlike ordinary Spectres, Wraiths are the product of extreme exotic contamination amplified by radiation exposure. The unstable fusion of exotic material and decaying human tissue accelerates mutation, reshaping the host into a crystalline pre

title: Zebra
intro: Zebras are social animals that live in herds. They are herbivores and use their stripes as a form of camouflage to confuse predators. This particular breed of Zebra are the direct result of the UDA engineering labs. Sample tissue has shown evidence of significant genetic divergence. It's theorized that continued exposure to exotic matter and/or terraforming enzymes may result in severe mutation. "The real question is: are they white with black stripes? Or are they black with white stripes? Steve bet against me and he still owes me from last time..."
